item.title: Cotton Valley celebrates with Christmas Parade
item.description: The rural town of Cotton Valley showcased its Christmas spirit with a downtown parade on Saturday, Dec. 20. Participants and onlookers celebrated the upcoming holiday with cheer, featuring floats highlighting Jesus, red tractors, Santa hats, and plenty of smiles and waves.

item.title: AG announces massive sex offender roundup
item.description: A multi-agency operation targeting sex offenders across Louisiana in recent months has resulted in the arrest of 67 people, Attorney General Liz Murrill announced during a recent press conference in Ruston.
